question.text: Which category of participants in commodity futures generally does NOT take physical delivery?

answer.text: Speculators and day traders who trade for profit on price movements

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.22, speculators/investors trade for profit, are not end users, and typically do not take physical delivery; day traders liquidate before the close of the same trading day. The Trap: Farmers, processors, and exporters are hedgers who may actually want to give or take delivery to fulfill physical business needs. Note: Speculators typically liquidate prior to or upon expiry and day traders exit intraday; this is the workbook's general description rather than an absolute requirement.
